The advance seasonally adjusted insured unemployment rate was 1.1% for the week ended Sept. 5, down 0.1 percentage point from the earlier week's unrevised rate, the Department of Labor said Thursday.

The advance number of actual initial claims under state programs on an unadjusted basis was 152,286 in the week ended Sept. 12, a decrease of 24,630 from the prior week. Seasonal factors expected a decrease of 16,515 from the previous week.
